## Definition of done (CLAUDE.md)
- [ ] All acceptance criteria met and evidenced above
- [ ] Tests added; full suite passes locally and in CI
- [ ] Lint / type-check / format clean
- [ ] Screenshot or clip for user-visible changes
- [ ] Docs updated
- [ ] Decision record added (if a meaningful choice was made)
- [ ] No secrets, real personal data or employer references
